details:
This update for libsoup fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-12547: Header "Proxy-Authorization" leads to credentials being send to different proxy after proxy switch
  (bsc#1272195).
- CVE-2026-12548: out-of-bounds read in multipart body parser due to an integer truncation (bsc#1272196).
- CVE-2026-15711: SoupWebsocketConnection: WebSocket remote denial of service via oversized control frame protocol
  violation (bsc#1271446).
- CVE-2026-15712: SoupClientMessageIOHTTP2: HTTP/2 GOAWAY frame parsing heap buffer over-read via invalid NUL-
  termination assumption (bsc#1271447).
- CVE-2026-15713: SoupCache: libsoup: HTTP/2 frame window exhaustion remote denial of service via memory leak
  (bsc#1271448).
- CVE-2026-15714: SoupMultipartInputStream: libsoup: Out-of-bounds read in soup_multipart_input_stream_read_headers
  via an oversized multipart boundary string (bsc#1271449).
- CVE-2026-66339: proxy credentials leak to destination server via `Proxy-Authorization` header in CONNECT tunnels
  (bsc#1273156).
- CVE-2026-102555: Heap buffer overflow via uninitialized length in data-URI base64 decoding (bsc#1283299).
- CVE-2026-102556: Heap buffer overflow from WebSocket Pong signal type confusion (bsc#1283300).
- CVE-2026-102557: Heap buffer overflow during WebSocket message reassembly (bsc#1283301).
- CVE-2026-102558: Heap buffer overflow during WebSocket receive-buffer growth (bsc#1283302).
- CVE-2026-102559: Heap buffer overflow during WebSocket client-frame masking (bsc#1283303).
- CVE-2026-102560: Heap buffer overflow during outgoing permessage-deflate buffer growth (bsc#1283304).
- CVE-2026-103399: incomplete request body draining in HTTP/1.x early responses can allow HTTP request smuggling
  (bsc#1283831).
